overview.description: The Defiance China Robotics ETF (CROB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund seeks total return by tracking a market-cap-weighted index of Chinese robotics companies. Security selection utilizes the ARTIS (Algorithmic Theme Identification System). CROB was launched on Aug 17, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
